paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.84% on average, with Hang Seng strongest (+0.52%) and Nasdaq weakest (-2.15%). Brent crude changed -1.39% to 108.33. Gold changed +0.15% to 4,187.5. Bitcoin changed +0.30% to 82,266.5703. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.098%, a relative move of +0.18%. Among the firms tracked, Equinor (+4.59%) and BP (+3.65%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Private equity finds next Asian frontier (FT World). Foreign firms make up majority of large buyout deals in Asia’s fourth-biggest economy Deals and capital markets: Private equity group Charlesbank closes one of the biggest law firm deals (FT Markets). Stake in Wood Smith Henning & Berman could herald wave of investments in US liability defence firms Geopolitics and trade: PwC revenue growth trails Deloitte and EY (FT Companies). Europe, Middle East and Africa revenues rose 0.7% following war in Iran and a slowdown in work for Saudi Arabian government Geopolitics and trade: US rate rises are being amplified in global markets (FT World). The Iran war and shifts by China are tightening the supply of dollars in international markets Also ranking highly: Robot factories and hypersonic missiles: JPMorgan Chase’s first $5 billion of defense investments (CNBC). With $5 billion already deployed off its balance sheet, JPMorgan Chase is racing ahead on direct investments in defense tech, hardware and supply chains.
